messages.content: You are a helpful Swift assistant. Answer accurately and state meaningful uncertainty.

Deployment target: tvOS 26.0. Framework: UIKit.

Our UIKit Apple TV screen displays result buttons from items with a stable ID, a visible title and a localized action name. Filtering is case-insensitive. Preserve the selected item only while it remains in the filtered results. Repeated IDs should reject an update without changing the old view. Ordinary button activation selects an item, but a retained button from an earlier render must not change the new results. Implement this and unit tests, including disabled buttons.
